component.name: AI Traffic Lights
component.summary: Traffic light overlay for terminal AI agent sessions

description.p: An always-on-top desktop overlay with one traffic light per AI agent session (Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini). Green means the agent finished and is waiting, yellow means it is working, red means it needs you: a question, a permission request or a failed tool.
Sessions are tracked through agent hooks that write local state files. The overlay also shows plan usage and reset times, and clicking a session focuses its terminal.
